name: The Brand Voice Compass & Sliders
diagnostic: What specific lexical, structural, and grammatical rules define each of our brand personality traits in practical writing?
artifact: Positive Definition: what the trait actively is
Negative Boundary: what it must never become
Side-by-side "Use This / Avoid That" copy examples
trap: Listing broad adjectives — Bold, Smart, Human — with no boundaries, leaving copywriters nothing to act on.
pedigreeFull: Modern verbal identity systems practice (derived from digital design system and docs-as-code methodologies).
artifactFull:
A Verbal Compass & Governance Guide defining:  
  - Trait Name  
  - Positive Definition (what the trait actively is)  
  - Negative Boundary (what the trait must never become)  
  - Side-by-side "Use This / Avoid That" copy examples.
trapFull: Listing broad tonal adjectives (such as "Bold," "Smart," or "Human") without defining concrete boundaries, leaving copywriters without actionable constraints.
